headline: Adopted higher elderly and disabled tax exemption income limits and a resolution backing Merrimack's opposition to an ICE detention center.
summary: Approved buying one 2027 Ford F-250 pick-up truck for up to $77,127, funded through the school department. Adopted ordinance O-26-026 on approvals for gasoline, electricity, and natural gas contracts. Sent Resolution R-26-080, which would amend a Harbor Homes housing grant agreement, to the Human Affairs Committee.
decisions: Approved purchase of one 2027 Ford F-250 pick-up truck through Grappone Ford for up to $77,127, 13-1.
Confirmed Dalia Ragas of Auburn, NH, as Deputy Treasurer/Tax Collector with an indefinite term.
Confirmed re-appointments of Lisa Tourangeau and Jennifer Bishop to the Citizen's Advisory Commission.
Adopted Ordinance O-26-025, increasing the elderly and disabled tax exemption income limits, 13-1.
Adopted Ordinance O-26-026 on approvals for gasoline, electricity, and natural gas contracts and purchasing extensions or renewals, 14-0.
Motion to indefinitely postpone Resolution R-26-015, supporting Merrimack's opposition to an ICE detention center, failed, 4-10.
Adopted Resolution R-26-015, supporting Merrimack's opposition to an ICE detention center, 9-5.
Referred Resolution R-26-080, amending the Harbor Homes grant agreement for transitional and permanent housing, to the Human Affairs Committee after its first reading.

A regular meeting of the Board of Aldermen was held Tuesday, November 10, 2026, at 7:56 p.m. in the aldermanic 
chamber, and duly noticed in two places, including the City’s website, in accordance with the requirements of RSA 91-
A:2 II. 
  
President Lori Wilshire presided; City Clerk Dan Healey recorded. 
 
Prayer was offered by City Clerk Dan Healey; Alderman James Ravan led in the Pledge to the Flag. 
 
Let’s start the meeting by taking a roll call attendance.  
 
The roll call was taken with 14 members of the Board of Aldermen present:  Alderman Clemons (via Zoom),  
Alderman Klee, Alderman Ravan, Alderwoman Smith, Alderman Thibeault, Alderman O’Brien, Alderman Dowd, 
Alderman Sullivan, Alderman Sennott (via Zoom), Alderman Johnson, Alderwoman Kelly, Alderman Morgan, Alderman 
Lopez, Alderman Wilshire.    
     
Alderman Gregg was recorded absent.   
 
Mayor James W. Donchess was also in attendance.
